reroute_reason: Bundle correctly routed: one context (Oslo / settlement / participant / reference / oslo_finality_moments, as_of 2026-09-14) returning both sections needed, status evidence_only. VPO NOK Rules §§23.1-23.3 cover both halves of the question (irrevocability on matching, bilateral cancellation with the Start-of-cycle deadline, the CCP close-out exception, hold provisions and the moment of entry), and the edition-approval section supplies the qualification. Oslo routes in topic-index.json were checked (approval_status, liquidity_duties, oslo_finality_moments, oslo_instruction_submission_settlement, oslo_preliminary_calculation_priority); nothing was obviously missing for the question as asked. The only supporting item not in evidence, the definition and timing of 'Start of Settlement' / 'Settlement cycle', is a nice-to-have detail rather than a mis-route, and is reported as an Open item.
notes: Core distinction drawn: Hold does not change revocability (§23.2 expressly extends §23.1 to held instructions) but does change the CSDR Article 39(2) moment of entry into the system (§23.3: not entered on matching, first entered once both Participants have marked it Released) - a matched held instruction is irrevocable-but-not-entered. The 'when' answer is given in two supported layers: unilateral revocability ends at Matching, and the last point at which the parties can still remove the instruction is the Start of the Settlement cycle in which it was to be processed, because the counterparty's confirmation must be received before then. The CCP close-out unilateral-cancellation exception and the separate rule for instructions that do not require matching are both covered. Qualifications kept attached throughout: English translation with Norwegian governing text, the cover's 'SUBJECT TO APPROVAL BY FINANSTILSYNET' reservation and unresolved gap G07, mode reference / basis reference_description (description of the 2 September 2024 edition, not a certification of the in-force approved text), review dates 14 September 2026 with source reviewed 13 September 2026, and the LIMITATION that VPO NOK is a Norwegian netting system outside T2S so T2S lifecycle rules and other CSDs' finality models (e.g. Milan SF1/SF2/SF3) must not be mapped onto it. No clock times or cycle counts were asserted, since none are in the evidence. Both retrievals were evidence_only and this is disclosed. Checker: 9/9 passed on the first run; no fix round was needed.
